questionEn: Why is the formula CO₂ and not CO for a stable carbon molecule with oxygen?
questionUz: Nima uchun kislorodli barqaror uglerod molekulasi uchun CO₂ formulasi CO emas?
choicesEn: Atoms tend towards a more stable electronic configuration (octet)
There is always twice as much oxygen
It's easier to write this way
choicesUz: Atomlar yanada barqaror elektron konfiguratsiyaga (okteta) intiladi.
Har doim ikki barobar ko'p kislorod mavjud
